text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's no good... At this rate...
Bright will—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's good to see you hard at work,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, you should stop for now. That
fear building up inside of you cannot be
easily shaken
off, no matter how
desperately you may try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not scared!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate my assessment.
Precisely
how much of your running do
you think I've
observed up to now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What's frightening you so much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I can't stop shaking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can still hear the crowd's cheers from
when I
crossed the finish line at the Oka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I realized how many voices there
were and
how many eyes were fixed on
me, watching my
every move...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Memories from the past suddenly
flooded my
mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And it was like I was once again that
little girl,
crying and sobbing as she
ran...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, that scene just keeps
replaying in
my mind, and I can't help
but start shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I won't be able to compete
in the Japanese Oaks! I've worked so
hard to get to this
point, and yet! And
yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm so scared!
I'm scared I'll revert to my
past self
in front of everyone... and in
front of Bright...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that truly what you fear?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is what you truly fear the possibility
that you'll
revert to your former self? Do you
truly think trembling will stop you from
competing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Those are terrifying prospects indeed.
But I think
your true fear lies elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My true fear?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When I was competing in the Japanese
Oaks, I
felt the same fear you are likely
experiencing
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You did?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Japanese Oaks drew closer, I felt
an
immense pressure weighing down on
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I felt I had to become my ideal self no
matter what. I had to fulfill the dreams
of those who wished to see me
accomplish what my mother
had.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The more I felt that I absolutely could
not lose,
the more I froze with fear. I was
terrified I wouldn't accomplish that
dream or reach that ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, I was eventually able to shift
my
perspective on that fear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I pondered the origin of that anxiety,
and that
was when I had an epiphany.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I was even harboring such
fears
proves that there are people
expecting great
things from me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And... they only do so because I
continuously
challenge myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will ask you once more, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What is it you fear? What is it you are
truly afraid
of?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I see now... The thing I'm really afraid
of—)

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mejiro Dober! Do
your best
at the Japanese Oaks too!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! You were so cool! I'll come see
you at the
Japanese Oaks for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Take my hand, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm afraid of letting Bright and everyone
else
down by betraying their
expectations...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But I'm only afraid of that because
there are
people who believe in me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(And because I'm trying so hard to push
myself
toward even greater heights!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. It seems you've reached the same
conclusion
I did.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To look at it differently, the source of
your fear is
actually what brought you all
this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Should you ever find yourself bereft of

confidence and frozen in place, listen to
the
words of those who believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am certain you can do this. After all,
Ryan and
Bright believe in you, as do I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And your trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All of you... believe in me... Even my
trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to your performance
at the
Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I haven't managed to stop
my
shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Despite knowing the real reason why I
shake, I'm
still scared. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in the Japanese Oaks
for all the
people that expect greatness
from me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I want you to let me carry that fe...
Please, let me shoulder that fear ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind. From now on, I
will believe in her more than anyone
else, and my cheers for
her will be
louder than the rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Your challenge is my challenge, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why do you always spew such
embarrassing stuff?
Honestly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, why are you always so... Still...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She mutters the rest of her thoughts in
such a
small voice that they're swallowed
up by the night
air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She mutters the rest of her thoughts in
such a
small voice that they're swallowed
up by the night
air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, I can tell by the determined
light
shining in her eyes that Mejiro
Dober is back in
fighting form.
